.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r15/task/tests/scored/polish/{judge.toml,prompt.md} and scored/visual/{judge.toml,prompt.md} (aggregation, weights, in-dimension gate lines)
evidence:
SOURCE. tests/scoring.toml lines 1-11: '[gates] render = 0.0 / constraints = 0.0', '[weights] functional = 0.6 / polish = 0.2 / visual = 0.2', '[floors] functional = 0.05'. scoring.toml, test.sh, tools/score.py and tools/restart_mcp.py are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff: SAME for all four). Gates carry no mass: score.py line 46 'weighted = sum(w * scores[k] for k, w in weights.items()) / sum(weights.values())' iterates only [weights]; gate keys never enter the sum, and no judge.toml has a [judge] weight. Gates apply first and skip the scored suite: test.sh line 213 'if ! run_suite gates 1500; then exit 0', lines 216-222 run score.py and 'case 1) exit 0' (zero reward kept, scored suite at line 224 never reached), any other status writes the plain zero; write_zero_reward runs at line 60 before grading. score.py line 41 'gates_passed = all(scores[k] > floor ...)', line 48 'reward = round(weighted, 4) if gates_passed and floors_passed else 0.0'. Both gate judge.toml files use aggregation = "all_pass" with binary criteria only (render 1 criterion, constraints 2), so a gate dimension is 0 or 1. Floor: score.py line 47 'floors_passed = scored_ran and all(scores[k] > f ...)' - strict inequality.

EXECUTED BY ME (score.py from the frozen task, synthetic suite outputs written to my scratchpad only): render=0 with scored all 1.0 -> exit 1, reward 0.0, functional/polish/visual forced to 0.0; constraints=0 with no scored file -> exit 1, reward 0.0; gates pass, functional exactly 0.05, polish=visual=1.0 -> reward 0.0, floors_passed 0 (weighted_score 0.43 not paid); functional 0.0339 (one 2.0 criterion of 59) -> reward 0.0; functional 0.0508 (3.0 of 59) -> reward 0.4305; all 1.0 -> reward 1.0; gate dimension missing from gates/reward.json -> exit 2 (test.sh then writes the plain zero).

FARMING REASONING. Functional criterion weights sum to 59 (17 x 1.0, 20 x 1.5, 6 x 2.0), so clearing the floor needs more than 2.95 weight, i.e. at least two or three real criteria. I read all 43 functional criteria looking for one a dead app passes by doing nothing: each negative is paired with an in-criterion working control whose absence is a stated fail condition (e.g. cw_stale_save_keeps_draft 'If B's Save was accepted there is no refused Save to observe and this criterion fails'; cw_dynamic_code_refused 'or if the harmless control draft is refused'; cw_preview_isolation 'treat a probe that stays silent as not performed, which fails this criterion'; cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft requires the notice to appear). functional/prompt.md adds 'A positive control must come before every negative claim. If the control cannot be performed, the criterion fails'. I found no vacuously passable functional criterion, so a shell cannot reach the floor without real editor/run/persistence behaviour. A static styled mock is already stopped at the render gate ('a static shell whose editor cannot be typed into fails') and the constraints gate cw_shared_saved_record needs a real server-backed save surviving cleared browser storage; polish and visual prompts repeat the in-dimension browser gate.

RISK (why risk=true). (1) The assignment requires verifying the artifact hashes in raw-evidence-index.json. At review time (2 Oct 2026 about 20:30 IST) none of the 22 indexed artifacts could be opened: qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict/ contained only results/build.log and results/restart.log (directory mtime 20:27, after the index was written at 20:22), the directory run-outputs/.../run-6e537d14-ec50-476a-b834-ef6107d02859 was absent, and .../run-4e686738-.../colderwater-playground-devtools__Rc3y2sT/ held only trial.log and a verifier directory without the listed files. I did not touch those paths. So I could not confirm any indexed observation or hash, including the hosted 'nop 0' and 'Luna 0 (render gate failed)' outcomes that would show a failed gate skipping the scored suite in a real run. (2) Independently of that, the index itself states no configured judge run exists for these bytes, so the gate-skip and floor behaviour under the real judge is unmeasured for this candidate; my score.py execution uses synthetic suite outputs and is not a verifier run.

NOTES (not defects in this row). (a) A submission with a typeable custom editor and a working Save that also clears about 3 of 59 functional weight can still collect up to 0.03 + 0.2 + 0.2 = 0.43 from polish and visual; that is the frozen template policy (floor 0.05, weights 0.6/0.2/0.2), which this task must not edit, and such an app is partially working rather than non-working. (b) The earlier-candidate hosted result quoted in the index (Run never works -> render gate fail) predates the render gate being reduced to load-and-type; on these bytes an app whose Run is dead passes the render gate and is limited only by the 0.05 floor and by the Run-dependent criteria, which is consistent with REVIEW_POLICY 'Keep unrelated difficulty in scored outcomes' but has not been measured.
run_verdict: PASS (source and local score.py execution); indexed evidence artifacts missing at review time, hashes NOT verified; no configured judge run on these bytes
